prayers.title: Only His Word Stands Tonight
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not about any one dream scene — it meets every curse spoken over you, every verdict passed against you, every decree muttered at a dark table while you slept. Whatever voice tried to speak last night, it does not get the final word over your life. Pray this aloud before you close your eyes, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Isaiah 8:10, "Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us" — every counsel gathered against me in the dream realm tonight, every word spoken to establish evil over my life, comes to nought and cannot stand, for God is with me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of Numbers 23:19, "God is not a man, that he should lie...hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?" — I decree that only what God has spoken over my life shall stand; every lying word, every false decree uttered against me while I slept is exposed as a lie and has no power to make itself good, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, as it is written in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways" — I decree light, not darkness, over my destiny tonight, and I cancel every decree the enemy tried to establish against me in my sleep; only my decree, rooted in Your Word, stands, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I stand on Proverbs 26:2, "As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come" — every curse spoken against me tonight is causeless, for I am redeemed and covered by the blood; let it fly on and find no resting place on my head, my home, or my family, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the Word in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof" — I silence every tongue that spoke death over me in a dream tonight; I decree only life, and every evil speaker shall eat the fruit of their own wicked words, in Jesus' mighty name!

I decree by Isaiah 55:11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please..." — I send Your Word against every evil word released over me tonight; Your Word shall accomplish what You please, and every contrary word returns to its sender void, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, by the promise in Jeremiah 1:12, "Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it" — hasten Your word of life over my sleep tonight, and let every hastened plan of darkness be frustrated and delayed, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, as in Psalm 107:20, "He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions" — send Your word now into every place a dream of destruction tried to touch my body, my mind, or my future, and let me be healed and delivered completely, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I stand on Psalm 119:89, "For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven" — no midnight decree, no witchcraft verdict, no dream tribunal can edit what is already settled in heaven concerning me; Your Word outranks every voice raised against me tonight, in Jesus' mighty name!

By the authority Christ gave me in Mark 11:23, "Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea...he shall have whatsoever he saith" — I speak to every mountain of evil decree raised against me in the dream realm: be thou removed and cast into the sea, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Your Word declares in Matthew 24:35, "Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away" — every dream-word spoken to alter my destiny shall pass away and be forgotten, but Your Word concerning my life stands forever, in the mighty name of Jesus!

So I seal tonight with Psalm 138:2, "...thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name" — every name invoked against me in the dream realm tonight, every title, every altar, every tribunal, bows to the Name above every name, because His Word outranks them all. I will wake in the morning carrying only the word He has spoken over me — untouched, unshaken, and unafraid — in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: No Table Holds My Name
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not about any one dream scene — it meets every evil altar, every midnight summons, every witchcraft table set to feed, mark, or bind you while you sleep. Whatever shape the invitation takes, you were never built to answer it. Pray this aloud before you close your eyes, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Deuteronomy 18:11, "Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer" — every necromancer, every familiar spirit, every evil summons sent to fetch me into a witchcraft gathering tonight is forbidden ground; it has no legal access to my spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the record of 1 Samuel 28:7, where Saul said, "Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her" — I decree that no agent of darkness shall seek me out, enquire after me, or summon my spirit to any altar, séance, or coven tonight; I am sought only by my Good Shepherd, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, as in Judges 6:28, "...the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it..." — every altar raised against my life in the dream realm tonight, every shrine built to hold my name, is cast down and cut down before the sun rises, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I stand on Isaiah 65:11, where it is written against those that "prepare a table for that troop, and...furnish the drink offering unto that number" — every table spread for me by witchcraft tonight, every seat reserved for me at a gathering I never agreed to, is overturned, and I refuse the portion poured out there, in Jesus' mighty name!

By the word of Malachi 1:7, "Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar..." — every polluted bread, every defiled meal, every strange food set before me in a dream tonight is rejected; I will not eat what darkness has prepared, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Your Word declares in Psalm 69:22, "Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap" — I decree that every table set to trap me tonight becomes a snare to the hand that set it; let the trap close on the trapper, not on me, in Jesus' mighty name!

I take my stand with Daniel 1:8, "Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank" — I purpose in my heart tonight that I will not defile myself with any portion served to me by a strange hand in my sleep, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of 1 Corinthians 10:21, "Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils" — I renounce every fellowship, every covenant meal, every cup offered me at any table of devils tonight; I am a partaker of the Lord's table alone, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, according to Esther 7:10, "So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai" — every gallows, every trap, every altar prepared for my downfall tonight swallows up the one who prepared it; let every plotter fall into their own plot, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I decree by Psalm 35:8, "Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall" — every net hidden for me in the dream realm tonight catches the hand that hid it, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Your Word declares in Psalm 23:5, "Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over" — the only table set for me tonight is the one You prepare; my head is anointed, my cup overflows, and no enemy's table can compete, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the promise of Luke 22:30, "That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom..." — I decree I belong at the King's table and no other; every evil invitation is declined, for my place is already set in the kingdom, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I seal tonight with Revelation 19:9, "Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb" — this is the only supper my name is written for. Every other altar, table, and summons is null and void over my life. I will wake in the morning untouched, unmarked, and unbound, seated only at the table of my King, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: The Grip That Could Not Hold
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it meets every hand, spirit, or power that pins you down, seals your mouth, or locks your legs so you cannot run, shout, or wake while you sleep. It does not matter what form the grip takes or where it meets you; it breaks the same way, by the Word and the name of Jesus. Pray it aloud before you close your eyes, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Psalm 3:5, "I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me" — before any power can pin me down, press on my chest, or hold me still in a dream tonight, I decree that the same sustaining hand already surrounds my lying down and my rising up, and no grip can outlast it, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of Job 36:16, "...he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness..." — every narrow, pressing grip assigned to trap me in a strait place in my sleep tonight is broken before it closes, for I am already carried into a broad place no hand can shut me into, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, as in Mark 7:35, "...his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain" — every string tied on my tongue to silence me the moment I try to call on Jesus in a dream tonight is loosed now, and I will speak plain the instant I need to, in Jesus' mighty name!

I stand on Luke 1:64, "And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God" — however any power tries to seal my mouth or freeze my voice while I sleep tonight, my mouth opens immediately, and the first word out of it is praise, not panic, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Isaiah 35:6 declares, "Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing" — every leg any power makes heavy, every foot that refuses to run, every voice that goes silent under pressure in a dream tonight receives strength to leap and a tongue to sing, in Jesus' mighty name!

By the record of Psalm 40:2, "He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings" — every pit, every miry clay, every sinking ground set beneath my feet in a dream tonight gives way, for my feet are already established on the Rock, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I decree by 2 Samuel 22:37, "Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip" — no hand on my ankles, no weight on my legs, no grip meant to make me slip or fall in my sleep tonight shall succeed, for my steps are already enlarged, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, by the pattern of Acts 16:26, "And suddenly there was a great earthquake...and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed" — I call for that same sudden shaking over every band, chain, or hand fastened on me in a dream tonight; let it come without warning and loose me before the grip can tighten, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I take hold of Psalm 118:5, "I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place" — the moment I call on the name of Jesus from inside any tight, pressing, or trapped place in a dream tonight, I am answered and set in a large place before the call is finished, in Jesus' mighty name!

By the cry of Psalm 142:7, "Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about" — every dream prison, cage, or holding cell built to keep my soul from rising tonight opens now, and I am compassed about by the righteous, not the wicked, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Romans 8:11 declares that "...he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you" — whatever part of my body any power tries to lock, numb, or paralyze while I sleep tonight is quickened now by the same Spirit that raised Christ from the dead, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I rise on Isaiah 40:29 and 31, "He giveth power to the faint...they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint" — every faintness, every weight, every heaviness pressed on me to hold me down in a dream tonight meets fresh strength, and I mount up, I run, I walk, unpinned and unafraid, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I seal tonight with 2 Corinthians 3:17, "...where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty" — every grip that reaches for me tonight finds only liberty where it expected a prisoner, for the Spirit of the Lord is here, and where He is, I am free. I will wake in the morning loosed in every joint, strong in every limb, and bold in every word, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Called Home Before Sunrise
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not aimed at one dream scene — it meets every spirit summons, every unauthorized journey, and every attempt to lift you, carry you, or detain you anywhere between sleep and waking, wherever you were taken and however far. Pray it aloud before you close your eyes, and let every journey not ordained by God be stopped before it starts, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Psalm 139:9-10, "If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea; Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me" — I decree that wherever any power attempts to carry me in a dream tonight, Your hand is already there to lead me and hold me, and I cannot be taken where You do not go, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of John 10:28, "I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand" — no hand, spirit, or summons has the right to pluck me out of my Father's hand tonight; I am held, and I am not for the taking, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Psalm 91:1 declares, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty" — I abide, I do not wander; every evil journey, flight, or transport assigned to remove me from that secret place tonight fails to move me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the pattern of Ezekiel 3:14, "So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away..." I decree that only the Spirit of the living God lifts and carries me — every counterfeit spirit, familiar spirit, or marine agent that attempts to lift or transport me in a dream tonight finds nothing to carry, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, as in Daniel 6:22, "My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me..." — send Your angel now to shut every mouth, every gate, and every hand assigned to seize me on any journey in the dream realm tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I stand on Acts 12:7, "...And his chains fell off from his hands" — every chain fastened on me the moment I am summoned or transported anywhere against my will tonight falls off now, and I walk out exactly as Peter walked out, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Hebrews 1:14 declares that angels are "ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation" — I dispatch ministering angels now to go and fetch me, spirit, soul, and body, from any place I have been summoned or carried tonight, and bring me home untouched, in Jesus' mighty name!

I decree by Psalm 23:4, "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me" — if any journey in a dream tonight leads through a dark valley, I walk it afraid of nothing, for You go before, beside, and behind me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, by the word of Luke 8:39, "Return to thine own house..." — I command every part of me summoned, detained, or transported anywhere outside Your will tonight: return now to my own house, my own bed, my own body, in the name of Jesus!

By the decree of Isaiah 54:15, "Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather against thee shall fall for thy sake" — every gathering, council, or table convened tonight to summon me on a journey I did not sanction is a gathering You did not call, and it falls for my sake, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Job 1:10 testifies that You make "an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side" — I decree that hedge stands round about me and my household tonight; no power can find a gap to pluck me out or carry me off, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I take hold of 2 Timothy 1:7, "God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind" — no evil journey, transport, or summons in a dream tonight shall plant fear in me; I keep a sound mind, full of power, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I seal tonight with Jude 1:24-25, "Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever" — kept from falling, kept from every evil journey, kept from every summons not of God, I rise tomorrow exactly where I lay down, whole and untaken, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: No Covenant in Strange Waters
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not aimed at one dream scene — it meets every water covenant, every evil baptism, every marine summons, and every river-crossing spirit assigned to seal, mark, or carry you off between sleep and waking, wherever the water showed up and whatever shape it wore. Pray it aloud before you close your eyes, and let every covenant sealed in strange waters be broken before it starts, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Isaiah 43:2, "When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee..." — I decree that every water covenant assigned to swallow me in a dream tonight meets Your presence first, and no river of affliction has the right to overflow my life, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of Galatians 3:27, "For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ," I reject every other baptism, initiation, or washing performed over me in the dream realm tonight — I am already baptized into Christ, sealed and clothed, and no strange water can baptize me into another covenant, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Jeremiah 2:13 rebukes every fountain that is not Yours: "...they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water" — every broken cistern offered to my spirit in a dream, every false fountain calling for my allegiance, is exposed and refused, in Jesus' mighty name!

I stand on the covenant of Genesis 9:15, "...the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh" — every flood of affliction, every covenant of destruction sealed over my destiny through dreams by night, is broken by the covenant God Himself remembers over my life, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I cry with David in Psalm 69:14-15, "...let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me" — every deep assigned to close its mouth on me in a dream tonight is commanded to open and let me go free, in Jesus' name!

Father, by the testimony of Jonah 2:6, "I went down to the bottoms of the mountains... yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God," I decree that every power holding me captive in a dream chamber beneath the waters is broken off, and I am brought up and set free, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the word of Exodus 15:10, "Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters," I decree that every pursuer who hunted me into deep waters in a dream sinks in my place tonight, while I walk out dry and untouched, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Mark 4:39 declares that You arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, "Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm" — I speak that same word over every raging water, every storm, every turbulent assignment sent against me in a dream tonight: Peace, be still, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I take hold of Matthew 14:31, "...Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?" — every attempt to let me sink in a dream, to drown my faith in fear, is met by the hand of Jesus that catches and holds me up, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Your Word in Psalm 18:16 declares, "He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters" — reach down tonight and draw me out of every water, every current, every covenant the enemy has prepared to carry me away in a dream, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the promise of Ezekiel 47:9, "...every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live... and every thing shall live whither the river cometh," I decree that every water I encounter in a dream from this night forward brings life and healing, never death, never covenant, never captivity, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Revelation 21:1 declares, "...and there was no more sea" — I decree over every marine power, every water-based kingdom assigned against my dreams, that your sea has no more claim, no more throne, and no more hold on my life, in the mighty name of Jesus!

So I seal tonight with Revelation 22:1, "And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb" — only this river flows over my sleep, only this water touches my destiny; every other water, every other covenant, every other altar is forever shut out, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: The Chase Is Over
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not aimed at one dream scene — it meets every spirit assigned to chase you, corner you, trap you, or hunt you down between sleep and waking, wherever the pursuit led and whatever shape the hunter wore. Pray it aloud before you close your eyes, and let every chase end before it starts, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Psalm 124:7, "Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped" — every snare spread for me in a dream tonight, every net set to close around me while I sleep, is broken before it closes, and I escape every trap untouched, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the command of Proverbs 6:5, "Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler," I deliver myself tonight from every hunter assigned to chase me, corner me, or run me down in the dream realm — every hand stretched out to hold me finds nothing but air, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Psalm 91:3 promises, "Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence" — I stand on that surely tonight; every trap laid by a dream-hunter is a trap You have already promised to spring empty, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I cry with David in Psalm 7:1, "O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me" — every power that pursues me through dream after dream, chasing me from street to street, from room to room, is stopped now and cannot land its blow, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, by the word of Nahum 1:8, "...darkness shall pursue his enemies," I reverse the chase tonight — every power that turned itself into my pursuer in a dream is turned into Your prey, and the darkness it hid in now hunts it down, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I decree by Deuteronomy 28:7, "The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways," — every pursuer that rose against me in the night comes one way and scatters seven ways before me, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Isaiah 41:12 declares, "Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee..." — every hunter that went looking for me in the dream realm tonight searches and finds nothing, for I am hidden where no contender can reach me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of Joshua 23:10, "One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you," I decree that I am no longer the chased but the one who chases — every power that hunted me in dreams past is now put to flight before me, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Your Word in Psalm 34:7 declares, "The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them" — let angels encamp around my bed tonight, a ring no hunter can cross, delivering me the instant any danger draws near, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I take refuge in Psalm 27:5, "For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me... he shall set me up upon a rock" — every chase assigned to wear me down in the dream realm ends at a hiding place no pursuer can find, high upon the Rock, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, by Exodus 14:14, "The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace," I lay down every struggle tonight — You fight every chase, every trap, every pursuit assigned against me while I simply rest, in the name of Jesus!

I stand on Psalm 17:8, "Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings" — every circle of hunters that surrounds me in a dream tonight is broken by the wings that already cover me, and I am too precious to be caught, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight, standing on Psalm 118:6-7, "The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?... The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me" — no hunter overtakes me, no snare holds me, no chase outruns the One who fights for me; I rise in the morning free, untouched, and unafraid, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Marked Only by the Blood
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not aimed at one dream scene — it meets every mark, label, writing, garment, or seal an enemy hand tries to place on you between sleep and sunrise, wherever it was attempted and whatever symbol it wore. Pray it aloud before you close your eyes, and let every foreign mark be erased and answered by the Blood before you wake, in Jesus' name.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Galatians 6:17, "I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus" — I carry only the mark of Jesus Christ tonight, and no other mark; every enemy stamp, seal, tattoo, or brand placed on me in any dream chamber is erased and nullified, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Lord, by the decree of Psalm 105:15, "Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm," I declare that every hand stretched out to mark me, brand me, or label me in the dream realm tonight is a hand that has touched what it was forbidden to touch — I command it to wither now, in the name of Jesus!

Father, Ephesians 1:13 declares that I am "sealed with that holy Spirit of promise" — every rival seal, every competing mark, every evil signature pressed upon me while I slept is overruled by the seal that already covers me; no second seal can stand where God has already sealed, in Jesus' mighty name!

I decree over every evil garment according to Revelation 7:14, "These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb" — every garment of mourning, confusion, sickness, or shame handed to me in a dream tonight is stripped off and washed white in that same blood, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Your Word in Isaiah 61:10 declares, "he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness..." — I refuse every substitute garment measured for me in the dark, and I receive only what You have already clothed me in, in the mighty name of Jesus!

By the authority of Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn," I condemn every tongue that spoke a mark over me tonight, and I declare that whatever weapon was formed against me in a dream has already failed, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, You said in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you" — I trample every serpent sent to bite, sting, or mark me in a dream tonight, and I declare that nothing assigned against me shall by any means hurt me, in the name of Jesus!

I decree by 1 John 4:4, "greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world" — every power that gathered to overpower me, overshadow me, or place its mark on me while I slept has met a greater One in me, and it is defeated before it begins, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, by Colossians 2:14, You have been "Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross" — every charge written against my name, every evil document signed over me in the dream realm tonight is blotted out and nailed to that same cross, in Jesus' mighty name!

I stand on Colossians 2:15, "having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it" — every principality that convened tonight to place a mark, a title, or a label upon me is openly put to shame, and I walk in that same triumph, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, as in Zechariah 3:3-4, when Joshua stood before the angel "clothed with filthy garments," You commanded, "Take away the filthy garments from him... I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment" — I command every filthy garment handed to me in a dream tonight to be stripped off, and I receive my change of raiment, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight, standing on Psalm 20:7-8, "Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God... They are brought down, and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright" — every chariot of darkness assembled against me is brought down and fallen, while I rise and stand upright, marked only by the blood, untouched until sunrise, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Arise and Go Forward
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it is heaven's fire sent against every assignment built to hold you in reverse: old altars calling your name, old cycles dressed up as new dreams, and any power still trying to make you relive what God has already closed. Pray it out loud before you sleep and let every attempt to turn you backward be answered by fire tonight.
points: Father, Your Word declares in Deuteronomy 1:6-7, "Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount: Turn you, and take your journey..." Every dream that parks me back at an old mountain, an old season, or a place I already left is cancelled now — I arise, I turn, and I take my journey forward, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Lord, Isaiah 43:18-19 commands me, "Remember ye not the former things... Behold, I will do a new thing..." Every power assigned to drag me back through old dreams, old defeats, and old chapters to make me relive them is silenced tonight — I will not remember what You have told me to forget, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, by the pattern of Philippians 3:13-14, "forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark..." every dream built to pull my eyes backward is overruled — I forget what is behind and I press forward untouched, in the name of Jesus!

I decree tonight according to Numbers 23:23, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel..." Every altar lit, every incense raised, every enchantment spoken over my name while I sleep finds no landing ground — there is no enchantment that can stand against this child of God, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Arise, O God, by the authority of Psalm 68:1, "Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him" — every witchcraft table convened to vote for my stagnation, every coven assembled to hold my file open, scatters now and flees before the fire of God, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every power assigned to chase me, trap me, or exchange my forward portion for a backward one in the dream realm tonight, hear the word of Psalm 35:5-6: "Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them. Let their way be dark and slippery..." You are now the hunted, your way is dark and slippery before you, and I walk free, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Father, Isaiah 61:3 promises me "the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness" — every garment of stagnation, every mark of sorrow, every covering of delay placed on me in a dream is stripped off and burned, and I receive the garment of praise and forward movement in its place, in the name of Jesus!

By the word of Isaiah 10:27, "his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing" — every yoke of backwardness fastened on me in the dark is destroyed by the anointing upon my life, and I rise up carrying nothing but freedom, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, Habakkuk 2:3 declares, "though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry" — every dream sent to convince me my vision has failed or my season will never come is a lie exposed tonight; what You have promised is already on its way and cannot be delayed, in the mighty name of Jesus!

I decree by Micah 7:8, "when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me" — every dream of falling, sinking, or sitting still in darkness is reversed; I arise, and where I sat in darkness, the light of the Lord now shines, in Jesus' mighty name!

According to Proverbs 4:18, "the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day" — every power assigned to dim my path, confuse my direction, or turn my road back on itself in the dream realm is defeated; my path shines brighter from tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Lord, Revelation 3:8 declares over me, "I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it" — every door shut against me in a dream, every gate locked to hold me back, every entrance barred by a hand in the dark has no power to stand; what You have opened, no destroyer can close, in Jesus' mighty name!

Father, by 2 Corinthians 5:17, "old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new" — every old cycle, old pattern, and old assignment trying to resurrect itself through a dream tonight has no claim on me; I am a new creature, and the old has no right to call me back, in the mighty name of Jesus!

So I decree over tonight, standing on Psalm 121:7-8, "The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil... The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore" — no backwardness, no altar, no chase, no mark, and no stagnation will touch me between now and sunrise. I will wake moving forward, not backward, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: No Destroyer Crosses My Door
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it is Exodus 12:23 sent ahead of you into the dark: a door marked by blood that no destroyer, however sent, is permitted to cross. Pray it out loud before you sleep and let the mark stand between you and every evil assignment tonight.
points: Father, by the word of Exodus 12:23, I mark my door with the blood of the Lamb tonight — when the destroyer comes to smite, let him see the blood and pass over me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every altar lit on my account before midnight, every incense raised, every name called over strange fire to summon me into a trap — I return your fire to your own house sevenfold, and your altar burns itself down, in the name of Jesus!

Every power assigned to chase me, trap me, or exchange my portion for another's in the dream realm tonight — I overtake you before you overtake me, I recover whatever you intended to carry away, and you fall into the pit you dug, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every mark, ring, garment, or covering any hand dares place on me while I sleep — my door is already marked by a better blood, and your mark cannot stick; catch fire and turn to ash before it ever touches me, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every witchcraft table, coven, or night session convened to review my file, cast lots over my name, or vote away my blessing before I wake — the fire of God crashes your session now, and you scatter before the meeting is called to order, in the name of Jesus!

Every pit dug, net spread, or snare set along my path between midnight and daybreak — the blood that marks my door marks my path also, and the digger falls into his own pit before the sun rises, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every gate assigned to work against me tonight — gate of delay, gate of sickness, gate of confusion, gate of sudden loss — finds my door already sealed, and no destroyer is permitted to come in to smite me, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, detained, exchanged, or carried anywhere outside the will of God tonight, I sound the alarm of recall now — ministering angels, go and fetch me home, spirit, soul, and body, untouched and unexchanged, in Jesus' mighty name!

Let the blood that marks my door mark every door under this roof tonight — every room, every bed, every name covered — so that the destroyer that cannot find one entrance cannot find another, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every evil court, secret tribunal, or night session convened to pass a verdict on my life while I rest — your judgment cannot cross my blood-marked door, and it returns to you unopened, in the name of Jesus!

So I decree over tonight: my door is marked, the destroyer has no entrance, and every evil assignment sent ahead of me arrives to a house the blood has already sealed. I will wake in the morning passed over, not touched, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Every Chain Snaps at Midnight
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not about one dream scene — it is fire sent ahead of you into every altar, every chase, every chain, and every evil assignment that waits for sleep before it moves. Pray it out loud before you close your eyes and let nothing hold what the blood has already loosed.
points: Every strange door shut against me, every gate locked to trap me inside any dream chamber tonight — I summon the fire of the Holy Ghost to melt every bolt, and I decree: no door closes on me that God Himself does not open, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every altar lit on my account before midnight, every summons sent to call my name over strange fire — I return your fire to your own house sevenfold, and I set your altar ablaze with a flame you cannot explain, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every power assigned to chase me, trap me, or exchange my portion for another's in the dream realm tonight — I overtake you before you overtake me, I recover whatever you intended to carry away, and I command: fall into your own net, in the name of Jesus!

Every mark, ring, garment, or covering any hand dares place on me while I sleep — catch fire on contact, turn to ash before it ever touches my skin, and let the hand that reached for me wither, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every chain, yoke, rope, or cord fashioned in the dark to bind me in my sleep — snap now by the fire that broke every bond at Calvary, and let me rise this morning walking free in every joint, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every strange covenant, union, or exchange of vows assigned to me in the spirit realm while I rest — I renounce it, I nullify it by the blood of Jesus, and I stand married only to my covenant with Christ, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every witchcraft table set to review my file, cast lots over my name, or vote away my blessing before I wake — the fire of God crashes your session now, your table catches flame, and your coven scatters before the meeting ends, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every dream engineered to drain my strength, waste my time, or delay my destiny while I sleep — I cancel the assignment, I reclaim every hour, and I decree that I will rise refreshed, not robbed, in the name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, arrested, or carried anywhere outside the will of God tonight, I sound the alarm of recall now — ministering angels, go and fetch me home, spirit, soul, and body, untouched and unexchanged, in Jesus' mighty name!

Let the fire that answered Elijah answer for me and for everyone under this roof tonight — every room sealed, every bed covered, every chain in this house broken before it is ever fastened, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight: every altar is quenched, every chain is broken, every table is scattered, and the only hand that holds me while I sleep is the hand of my Father. I will wake in the morning loosed, covered, and victorious, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: No Verdict Against Me Stands
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer meets every secret court convened in the dark — every accuser summoned, every false charge filed, every gavel raised while you cannot answer — with a Blood that has already settled your case. Pray it out loud before you sleep and let no verdict stand that Heaven did not sign.
points: Every secret court convened against me tonight — every accuser summoned, every false witness sworn in, every gavel lifted to pass sentence on my life — I plead the blood of Jesus over the docket, and I decree: no verdict stands that was not signed in Heaven, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every altar lit on my account before midnight, every incense raised, every name called over fire that is not Mine — catch the fire you did not kindle, scatter to ash before dawn, and let every officiating hand burn in the name of Jesus!

Every power assigned to chase me, trap me, or trade my portion for another's in the dream realm tonight — I bind you with chains of fire, and I command: run into your own net, fall into your own pit, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every mark, ring, garment, or covering any hand dares place on me while I sleep — I refuse it, I reject it, I command it to catch fire on contact and turn to smoke before it ever touches my skin, in the name of Jesus!

Every witchcraft table set to review my file, cast lots over my name, or vote away my blessing — the fire of God invades your session now, your table catches flame, and your coven scatters before you finish your meeting, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every ledger of accusation opened against me in the dark, every record kept to use against my morning — I set it ablaze by the blood of Jesus, and let it burn to nothing before the sun rises, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, arrested, exchanged, or carried anywhere outside the will of God tonight, I sound the alarm of recall now — ministering angels, go and fetch me home, spirit, soul, and body, untouched and unexchanged, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every evil decree spoken over my sleep, every curse timed for the midnight hour, every word released to work while I cannot answer — I answer now, wide awake in the Spirit: it shall not stand, it shall not work, it is overruled, in the name of Jesus!

Let the fire that answered Elijah answer for me and for everyone under this roof tonight — every room sealed, every bed covered, every name in this house hidden under the blood where no weapon formed in the dark can find its mark, in Jesus' mighty name!

I summon the Advocate who ever lives to plead for me — Jesus Christ, the Righteous Judge's own Son — to stand in the gate of midnight, answer every charge, overturn every verdict, and hold the field until I wake, in the name of Jesus!

So I decree over tonight: the court of hell is adjourned, the case against me is dismissed, and the only word that stands over my sleep is the word of my Father. I will wake in the morning free, covered, and victorious, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Chariots of Fire Surround Me
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it is Elisha's open-eyed vision loosed ahead of you into the dark: a mountain full of horses and chariots of fire stationed round about you before any enemy arrives. Pray it out loud and let the fire take its position before you sleep.
points: Father, as You opened the eyes of Elisha's servant, open the eyes of my spirit tonight and let me see what is already true — horses and chariots of fire stationed round about me, before my bed, behind my back, and over every border of my sleep, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every evil altar lit anywhere on my account tonight, every candle struck, every incantation spoken over my name — a chariot of fire rides in before the rite is finished, and that altar goes up in flames, in the name of Jesus!

Every power that rises to chase me, waits to trap me, or schemes to trade my portion for another's in the dream realm tonight runs straight into a wall of horsemen it never saw coming and is scattered, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every mark, ring, garment, or covering any hand dares lift toward me while I sleep tonight catches fire in the hand that holds it and falls to ash before it ever reaches my skin, in the name of Jesus!

Every witchcraft table, coven, or secret session convened tonight to study my file, call my name, or cast a vote over my life looks up to find chariots of fire ringing the room and scatters in terror, in Jesus' mighty name!
Every pit dug, net spread, or snare set along my path between midnight and daybreak — the wheels of fire roll over it first, and the digger falls into what was dug for me, in the name of Jesus!

Every gate assigned to work against me tonight — gate of delay, gate of sickness, gate of confusion, gate of sudden loss — finds a chariot of fire parked across its threshold and shall not open, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, detained, or carried anywhere outside my ring of fire tonight, I sound the trumpet of recall now — mount up on chariots of fire and bring me home, spirit, soul, and body, whole and untouched, in Jesus' mighty name!

Let the same mountain full of horses and chariots ring my household tonight — every room, every bed, every name under this roof — so that no darkness assigned against this house finds a way past the fire, in the name of Jesus!

Every evil court, secret tribunal, or night session convened to pass a verdict on my life while I rest meets a chariot of fire standing at its gate — your judgment is turned back, and I appeal to a better Court whose Judge is my Father, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight: the mountain is full of horses, the valley is full of fire, and I am not the one surrounded — my enemies are. I will rise in the morning exactly as I lay down: covered, untouched, and victorious, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: A Wall of Fire Round About Me
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it is Zechariah's promise sent ahead of you into the dark: a wall of fire no power can climb, tunnel under, or see through. Pray it out loud and let the fire stand before you sleep.
points: Father, by the authority of Zechariah 2:5, I decree a wall of fire round about me tonight — before my body, behind my back, over my bed, and around every border of my sleep — no power shall cross it, in the mighty name of Jesus!
Every evil altar lit on the far side of my wall of fire tonight, burn down to ash before the hand that struck the match can finish its rites, in the name of Jesus!

Any power that runs to chase me, waits to trap me, or schemes to trade my portion for another's in the dream realm tonight meets my wall of fire first and is turned back scorched, in Jesus' mighty name!
Every mark, ring, garment, or covering any hand attempts to throw over my wall of fire tonight catches flame in the air and falls to ash before it ever reaches my skin, in the name of Jesus!

Every witchcraft table set to study me, call my name, or cast a vote over my life tonight loses my scent and my shadow the moment my wall of fire rises — you are searching for someone you cannot find, in Jesus' mighty name!
Every pit dug for me in the dream realm tonight, by the word of the Lord, swallows its own digger before the sun comes up, in the name of Jesus!
Every rope, net, or chain thrown across my wall of fire tonight burns through before it ever tightens — I was not born to be bound, and I will not be bound in my sleep, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every gate assigned to work against me between midnight and daybreak — gate of delay, gate of sickness, gate of confusion, gate of loss — stands outside my wall of fire and shall not open, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, detained, or carried anywhere outside my wall of fire tonight, I sound the trumpet of recall now — spirit, soul, and body, come home whole and untouched, in Jesus' mighty name!

Let my wall of fire stretch over my household tonight — every room, every bed, every name under this roof covered — so that no darkness assigned against this house gets past the flame, in the name of Jesus!

Every evil court convened outside my wall tonight to pass a verdict on my life, your judgment cannot cross the fire and cannot find me — I stand inside a better court, and the Judge of that court is my Father, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight: the wall is fire, the fire is the blood, and the blood has already spoken — no weapon formed in the dark shall prosper, no power gathered against me shall find a way in, and I will rise in the morning exactly as I lay down: covered, untouched, and victorious, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: The Blood Still Speaks
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer is not a guess at your dream — it is the blood of Jesus applied over your life before the lights go out, the same blood that made every destroyer pass over in Egypt. Pray it out loud and mean it; the blood still speaks.
points: Father, tonight I apply the blood of Jesus over the doorposts of my life the way Israel applied it over Egypt, and I decree that every destroyer sent to pass through my sleep passes over me and finds nothing to touch, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every evil altar lit on my behalf tonight — in a dream, in a shrine, in a hidden chamber I will never see — I set it on fire from here by the blood of the Lamb! Let it consume the hand that lit it, in the name of Jesus!

If any power rises to chase me, trap me, or trade my destiny for another's in the dream realm tonight, I decree disgrace upon that power! Let the chaser be chased, let the trapper be trapped, let no exchange concerning my life stand, in Jesus' mighty name!

If any hand in the dark attempts to place a mark, a ring, a garment, or any evil covering on my body while I sleep, let fire swallow it before it touches me! I am already covered in the blood and clothed in righteousness — no foreign mark shall be found on me, in the name of Jesus!

Every witchcraft table, coven, or secret session gathered tonight to call my name or cast a vote over my life, I overturn your table by fire and scatter your gathering before you rise, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every ledger being written against me in the dark — every false account, every manufactured debt, every accusation drawn up while I sleep — I set it ablaze and I plead the blood of Jesus over every page! Let every charge be blotted out before morning, in the name of Jesus!

Every chain forged for my hands or feet in the dream realm tonight, snap now by the power in the blood of Jesus! I was not born to be bound, and I will not be bound in my sleep, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every gate assigned to work against me between midnight and daybreak — gate of delay, gate of loss, gate of confusion, gate of exchange — hear the word of the Lord and be shut! Only the gates my Father opens shall open over my life tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, detained, or carried anywhere I did not send it, I sound the trumpet of recall right now by the blood of Jesus — spirit, soul, and body, return to my bed whole and untouched, in Jesus' mighty name!

Let the lamp of the Lord stay lit over my house tonight — no darkness assigned against this household shall overtake it, for greater is He that is in me than any power gathered outside, in the name of Jesus!

Every evil court convened to judge me while I rest, I reject your verdict and I appeal to the Court of Heaven, where the blood of Jesus has already spoken a better word than any charge laid against me, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight: the blood has already spoken, the destroyer must pass over, every chain is broken, and no power gathered against me shall see the morning with its plan intact! I lay down in peace, I rise in victory, untouched and unshaken, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: The Watchman Does Not Sleep
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer — not a guess at what you'll see in the dream realm, but a decree that heaven's watchman is stationed over you before your head ever touches the pillow. Pray it out loud and mean every word; fire answers fire.
points: Father, Your word says the One who keeps me shall neither slumber nor sleep — so tonight I post that same watchman over every gate of my life, and I decree that nothing crosses into my dream realm without His permission, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every evil altar being prepared for my sake tonight — in the forest, in the river, in the secret room, on the rooftop — I set it ablaze from here by the fire of the Holy Ghost! Let the hand that would strike a match against me be scorched by its own fire, in Jesus' mighty name!

If any power rises to pursue me in my sleep tonight, I decree confusion into the camp of my pursuers! Let them run the way they came, let their legs fail them in the chase, for I am hidden under the shadow of the Almighty, in the name of Jesus!

Every snare laid along my path between midnight and daybreak, every net stretched low where my spirit must pass, be torn apart by fire before my feet ever reach it! The fowler's trap shall catch nothing that belongs to me, in Jesus' mighty name!

If any hand attempts to place a mark, a garment, a ring, or any evil covering upon my body while I sleep tonight, let that hand wither on contact! I am already clothed in the righteousness of Christ — no foreign covering, no strange mark, shall be found on me, in the name of Jesus!

Every coven, cult, or witchcraft table sitting in session tonight to call my name, to cast lots over my destiny, or to vote on my future — I overturn your table by fire! Scatter, and carry no resolution concerning my life out of that meeting, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every secret court, tribunal, or night session convened to pass judgment on me while I rest, I plead the blood of Jesus over every charge and I appeal straight to the Court of Heaven! No gavel falls against me tonight that the Righteous Judge has not first approved, in Jesus' name!

Every gate assigned to work against me at midnight — gate of delay, gate of sickness, gate of sudden loss, gate of confusion — hear the word of the Lord: be shut, and stay shut! Only the gates my Father ordains shall open over my life tonight, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If my spirit has been summoned, detained, or transported anywhere I did not send it, I sound the trumpet of recall right now, by the blood of Jesus — spirit, soul, and body, return to my bed whole, untouched, and unshaken, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every mirror, mask, or counterfeit image of me being used in the dream realm tonight to act, speak, or sign on my behalf, catch fire now and be exposed as a fraud before every witness gathered! There is only one of me, and I am sealed in Christ, in the name of Jesus!

Every clock and calendar being tampered with on my account in the dark tonight, I command it to answer only to God's time! No night contractor shall rush my ruin, stall my blessing, or steal one hour assigned to my harvest, in Jesus' mighty name!

So I decree over tonight: the watchman does not sleep, the gates obey only my Father's voice, and every power that gathered against me scatters before the fire goes out! I lay down in peace, I rise in victory, untouched and uncompromised, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: No Exchange Tonight
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer — not a guess at what you'll see in the dream realm, but a decree over every altar, every chase, and every attempted exchange that waits for the unguarded hours of sleep. Pray it out loud and mean every word; fire answers fire.
points: Father, by the blood of Jesus, I shut down every evil altar erected for my sake tonight — no priest, no diviner, no night strategist shall light a candle, break a kola, or call a name over my life and get an answer! Every altar against me is overturned, in the mighty name of Jesus!

If any power chases me in the dream realm tonight, I turn and stand in the name of Jesus — I am not the one running! Every pursuer loses strength, loses breath, and loses ground, and I outrun no one, because greater is He that is in me, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every net, snare, cage, or hidden trap set for my spirit between midnight and the breaking of day, I command it to close on empty air! My feet shall not be caught where my enemies have dug, in the name of Jesus!

I refuse every attempted exchange tonight — no one trades their sickness for my health, their poverty for my supply, their short years for my long life, or their curse for my blessing! What is mine remains mine, sealed by the blood of Jesus!

Every evil court, secret tribunal, or night session convened to pass judgment on my life while I sleep, I plead the blood of Jesus and I appeal to the Court of Heaven! No verdict stands against me that the Judge of all the earth has not signed, in Jesus' name!

Any file, ledger, or book opened against my name, my family, or my calling in the spirit realm tonight, I command it blotted out by the blood of the Lamb! Only the Book of Life carries my name, and no other register has authority to write me down, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every mirror, double, mask, or counterfeit version of me being paraded in the dream realm tonight, catch fire now and be exposed! There is only one of me, and I am hidden in Christ — no impostor speaks or acts in my name, in the name of Jesus!

Every gate assigned to open against me at midnight — gate of delay, gate of confusion, gate of sudden loss — I shut you by the blood of Jesus, and I lock you with the key of the Holy Ghost! No gate opens tonight except the gates my Father ordains, in Jesus' mighty name!

If my spirit is summoned, transported, or detained anywhere I did not send it tonight, I invoke the blood of Jesus and I command my immediate, full recall — spirit, soul, and body — back to my bed, untouched and unshaken, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every clock, calendar, or season being tampered with on my behalf in the dark tonight, I command it to run on God's time alone! No night operator steals my years, rushes my ruin, or delays my harvest, in the name of Jesus!

Every witch, wizard, familiar spirit, marine agent, or night contractor assigned to negotiate, bargain, or trade concerning my life tonight — I cancel every meeting! There is nothing to discuss, nothing to sign, and nothing to collect, in Jesus' name!

So I decree over tonight: no altar shall burn for me that I did not kindle, no gate shall open against me that heaven did not ordain, and no exchange shall stand that was not signed by my own hand and sealed by the blood of the Lamb. I sleep in peace, I rise in victory, covered and untouched, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Scattering the Witchcraft Table
prayers.intro: Tonight's shield prayer — not about what you'll dream, but about every table spread, every summons sent, and every mark aimed at you in the dark before sleep ever closes your eyes. Pray it out loud and mean every word; fire answers fire.
points: Father, by the blood of Jesus, I refuse every summons sent to my spirit tonight — no coven, no council, no ancestral gathering, no witchcraft assembly has the right to call me and expect an answer! I am not available, I do not attend, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Every table spread for me in the dream realm tonight — witchcraft table, satanic buffet, covenant feast laid by hands I cannot see — catch fire now and be overturned before I am ever served, in the name of Jesus!

Any garment, uniform, ring, cloth, or cloak fitted on my body, my head, or my spirit while I sleep tonight, I strip it off and set it ablaze where it falls! I wear the garment of righteousness and no other, in Jesus' mighty name!

Whatever picture, image, name tag, or likeness of me is being used for an evil working in the dream realm tonight, I command it destroyed by fire! No power manipulates my image while my body rests — I am hidden in Christ, in Jesus' name!

Every evil covenant, pact, marriage, or blood bond anyone attempts to seal with me in a dream tonight, without my spirit's consent, I declare null, void, and forever broken by the blood of Jesus! I belong to Christ alone, in His mighty name!

Every padlock, chain, rope, or seal fastened on my destiny, my womb, my business, or my finances through a dream tonight, I command it to shatter now! What God has opened, no night operator shall shut, in the name of Jesus!

If my spirit is carried, transported, or kidnapped to any evil location in the dream realm tonight, I invoke the blood of Jesus and I command my immediate, full return — body, soul, and spirit — safely to my bed, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every voice that calls my name in the dark tonight to pull me into the dream realm against my will, I silence you! I answer only to the Shepherd's voice, and I know His voice — every stranger's voice is a stranger to me, in the name of Jesus!

Any blood drawn, any sacrifice offered, any covenant sealed in my name or over my image in a dream tonight, I reject and reverse it completely! Only the blood of Jesus speaks over my life, and it speaks better things, in His mighty name!

If I am arrested, tried, chained, or detained by any power in a dream tonight, I plead the blood of Jesus as my Advocate and I command my unconditional release now, with every charge against me dropped, in the name of Jesus!

Every witch, wizard, marine agent, familiar spirit, or night operator assigned to visit, feed from, or drain me while I sleep tonight — your assignment is terminated! Fire consumes your camp before you ever reach my door, in Jesus' name!

So I decree over tonight: no table shall be spread for me that I did not set, no mark shall settle on me that heaven did not place, and no voice shall move me that is not my Father's. I sleep in peace, I rise in victory, covered and untouched, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Breaking Every Midnight Decree
prayers.intro: A shield prayer for tonight — not about what you dreamed, but about every decree spoken against you in the dark before you ever close your eyes. Pray this out loud. Fire answers fire.
points: Father, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel every decree, every verdict, every sentence passed against my life in any dream court sitting tonight. No judgment entered against me in my sleep shall stand, for the Judge of all the earth has not signed it, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every parliament of darkness, every tribunal, every satanic council convened to review my file while I sleep — I set fire to your chamber now! Scatter, before the thunder of the Holy Ghost scatters you, in the name of Jesus!

Any book, ledger, or register where my name has been written down for an evil assignment tonight — I command it blotted out and burned, and I write over it with the blood of the Lamb! My name belongs in the Book of Life, nowhere else, in Jesus' name!

If I am pursued, hunted, or driven in a dream tonight, let the pursuer fall into the pit dug for me instead! If I am caged, roped, netted, or locked in, every chain breaks now, every door flies open, and I walk out free by fire, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Whatever swap is being arranged against me in the dark tonight — my destiny for a delay, my health for a sickness, my joy for a sorrow, my future for someone's past — I refuse the exchange, I reverse the exchange, and I send it back empty-handed, in Jesus' name!

Every evil seal, mark, tattoo, ring, veil, or garment any hand tries to fix on me in a dream tonight, I tear it off before it settles and I set it ablaze where it falls! I wear no covering but righteousness, I carry no seal but the Holy Ghost, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every altar raised against me tonight — ancestral altar, marine altar, village altar, graveyard altar, altar in a shrine I have never seen — catch fire now, stone by stone! No blood poured there, no incantation spoken there, has any claim on me, in the name of Jesus!

Whatever is cooked, served, or passed to me to eat or drink in a dream tonight, I reject it, I vomit it out, and I command the hand that prepared it to eat it instead! I feed only at the table of the Lord, in Jesus' mighty name!

Every marine spirit, every water power, every operator from the kingdom under the sea assigned to trouble my rest tonight — I command your waters to dry up before my presence! You will not drown what the blood of Jesus has already covered!

If I fly, fall, sink, or struggle to scream in a dream tonight, let it be the enemy's camp that falls, not me! I decree that angels of fire bear me up, and every power simulating my death, loss, or defeat in the dream realm dies in my place, in Jesus' name!

Father, every door shut against me, every virtue confiscated, every good thing buried in a grave, a coffin, or a locked room by dream wickedness in seasons past — exhume it, resurrect it, and hand it back to me now, multiplied, by fire, in Jesus' name!

So I decree over tonight: no weapon formed against me in my sleep shall prosper, no tongue that rises against me in the dark shall be justified. My rest is holy ground, my dreams are patrolled by fire, and I rise in the morning with nothing stolen and nothing broken — covered, untouchable, and free, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Scattering the Midnight Assembly
prayers.intro: A shield prayer for tonight — not about what you dreamed, but about what stands against the camp before you ever close your eyes. Pray this out loud. Fire answers fire.
points: Father, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I plead the blood of the Lamb over my spirit, my soul, my body, my bed, and the threshold of my sleep tonight. Let every demonic appointment written against me for this night be torn off the register and burned to ashes, in Jesus' name!

Every witchcraft table, every coven, every midnight assembly, every satanic conference summoned to sit over my matters while I sleep — I scatter you now by fire! Let the thunder of the Holy Ghost break up every meeting convened against my life, my family, and my destiny tonight!

Any dream pot stirred for me, any dream kitchen lit for me, any cauldron cooking a portion meant to be fed to me in my sleep — I set it ablaze before it is served! What is cooked on a witchcraft fire will never enter my mouth, in the name of Jesus!

If I am hunted in a dream tonight, I decree the hunter will not overtake me. If I am chased, I will not be caught. If I am caged, bound, netted, or trapped, every chain snaps now by the power that split the Red Sea — I walk out free, in Jesus' mighty name!

Whatever exchange is being arranged against me tonight — my health for sickness, my breakthrough for delay, my fruitfulness for barrenness, my peace for torment, my life for death — I stand in the gate and I reject the exchange! It is reversed, and it falls back on the sender, in Jesus' name!

Every evil mark, every garment, every ring, chain, veil, or covenant object any hand attempts to place on me in a dream tonight — I strip it off, I refuse to wear it, and I command it to burn where it stands! I carry no enemy's label — I am marked only by the blood of Jesus!

Any altar raised against me through dreams — ancestral altar, marine altar, graveyard altar, forest altar, altar of the night — I locate you in the spirit and I set you on fire! No covenant spoken over me at any altar I never built shall stand, in the name of Jesus!

If anything is offered to me to eat or to drink in a dream tonight, I vomit it out by the fire of the Holy Ghost! I receive no covenant meal from the table of darkness — my portion is the bread and the cup of the Lord alone!

I decree a wall of fire and a company of warring angels stationed round my sleep tonight — at the door, at the window, at the gate of my dreams. No weapon fashioned against me in the dream realm shall prosper, and every voice raised against me in secret, I silence it in Jesus' name!
Father, every virtue, strength, sound sleep, open door, and good thing stolen from me through dreams in seasons past — recover it by fire and restore it to me sevenfold, according to Your Word!

So I decree: this night belongs to God and not to the enemy. My going to bed is blessed, my sleep is blessed, my rising is blessed. Whatever was planned against me in the dark has already failed, because greater is He that is in me than he that is in the world. Every gate is shut, every altar is down, every yoke is broken — I am covered, I am free, in the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥

prayers.title: Shutting the Gates of the Night
prayers.intro: A shield prayer for tonight — not about what you dreamed, but about what you're covered by before you ever close your eyes. Pray this out loud. Fire answers fire.
points: Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come under the blood of the Lamb before I lay my head down tonight. I plead that blood over my mind, my spirit man, my bed, and every gate of my sleep. Let every enemy assignment scheduled against me in the night season be cancelled right now, in Jesus' name!

I decree that every evil altar, every witchcraft summons, every dream kitchen, every satanic council that has called a meeting over my life tonight — catch fire now! Let the fire of the Holy Ghost scatter every gathering convened against my destiny while I sleep!

Every spirit that attempts to approach me in the dream tonight in any form — human, animal, shadow, familiar face, or stranger — I say you have no legal right to my sleep. I am covered by the blood, I am hidden in Christ, and you cannot locate what God has hidden!

Any gate opened into my life through fear, ignorance, curiosity, trauma, or ancestral covenant, through which dream attackers have gained access before — I shut you now by the blood of Jesus, and I seal you with fire. No further entry, in the mighty name of Jesus!

Whatever the enemy is attempting to exchange tonight — sickness for my health, delay for my breakthrough, barrenness for my fruitfulness, confusion for my clarity, death for my life — I reject the exchange! I reverse it by the power of the resurrection! What is Mine stays Mine!

If I am chased in a dream tonight, I decree I will not be caught. If I am trapped, I decree the trap will not hold. If I am buried, sunk, bound, stripped, or robbed in a dream, I decree by the authority of the name of Jesus that it has no power to manifest in my waking life!

Every evil mark, garment, ring, or covenant any spirit attempts to place on me in a dream tonight — I refuse it, I put it off, and I burn it by fire! I did not sign for it, I do not receive it, and it has no claim over me, in Jesus' mighty name!

I decree angels of fire, encamped round about me, standing guard at the gate of my sleep tonight. No weapon formed against me in the dream realm shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in a hidden place, I condemn it, in the name of Jesus!

Father, I ask You to recover by fire everything stolen from me through dreams in seasons past — virtue, strength, destiny items, open doors, sound sleep, peace of mind. Let it be restored to me, sevenfold, according to Your Word!

So I decree: my sleep is sweet tonight, my spirit is alert even while my body rests, and whatever I dream — or don't — I wake up tomorrow further ahead than the enemy pushed to set me back. Yokes are broken. Gates are shut. I am covered. In the mighty, all-consuming name of Jesus Christ, amen! 🔥
